_readme: Drives /deals.html. Update 'checked' and any radio's entry when a price or code changes, then rebuild. Only list a code or sale you've confirmed on the seller's page. Radios not listed under 'items' show their bench price and 'No holiday deal confirmed yet'.

radtel-p8.note: Radtel's site is running a store-wide "mid-season sale" banner. The P8 2-pack shows $159 (Nov 22). An earlier $99 listing is sold out. Compare with the Amazon price before you buy.

herda-hp1.note: Herda sells by quote. Ask for the pair price and the $25/yr renewal terms in writing, and ask about holiday pricing.
